query:
SELECT 
  rp.id,
  DATE_FORMAT(rp.paidDate, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%i') as data_pagamento,
  rp.paidAmount,
  p.name
FROM receivablePayments rp
JOIN partners p ON rp.customerId = p.id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Vitor Hugo%'
ORDER BY rp.paidDate DESC
